summary: IDT Corporation filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing via Item 7.01 and Item 8.01 that its Board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable October 14, 2026 to holders of record October 5, 2026. No special-situation event is present: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change. The filing is a routine capital-return disclosure with no advisor named and no structural mechanics beyond standard record and payment dates. The risk-arb angle is immaterial; watch only for any future shift in dividend policy or capital-return cadence.
